What’s happening outside the classroom is as important as what happens inside. Give every student, whether residential, commuter, or online, one connected place to find their community, access support, and navigate campus life with confidence. When students feel connected, they stay. With CampusGroups, you’ll be able to prove it by correlating co-curriculars with retention.

CampusGroups gives students guided pathways and easy access to resources, so they always know their next step. Onboarding checklists and scheduling tools help them build relationships with peers, staff, and advisors before day one, letting them set goals and book mentor time right from their phone.

CampusGroups connects every student with the right people, programs, and clubs through a single platform, making it easy to find a group that fits their interests, and improve college student retention.

Results show up across campuses: students who get involved show a 90% retention rate, versus 74% for those who don’t, and at the University of Wisconsin-Stout, students who attend Involvement Center programs see an 8.0% higher retention rate than peers who don’t.

Students don’t read campus emails, so updates about deadlines, financial aid, and advising can easily get lost across too many scattered threads. When students miss this information, small problems can grow into bigger ones before anyone notices.

In addition to email, CampusGroups adds communication to the mobile app students already use every day. Targeted push alerts, in-app messages, and community feeds keep students informed about what matters most, while giving staff insight into trends that may affect retention.

Student Affairs teams often have more engagement data spread across too many disparate systems, so connecting it to retention and student success can take days. By then, the moment to act has often already passed.
